title: Lightly Smoky Ukrainian Nectarine Wrap
description: A quick and easy Ukrainian dish featuring nectarines and ssam wrap, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe is nut-free friendly and has a smoky flavor.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, brown sugar, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the ssam wrap pieces with olive oil on both sides.
Place the ssam wrap pieces on the preheated skillet or griddle and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Spread a tablespoon of the smoked paprika mixture on each ssam wrap piece.
Top each ssam wrap piece with diced nectarines.
Fold the ssam wrap pieces in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the nectarines are slightly caramelized.
